name: Doba
summary: Dropshipping marketplace that connects online sellers with wholesale suppliers, with one-click listing to Shopify, eBay, Amazon, TikTok Shop and other channels, inventory lists and AI listing tools.
best_for: online sellers on Shopify, eBay, Amazon, TikTok Shop and similar channels who want to dropship from one wholesale catalogue and push listings into several stores, starting from the Basic tier
skip_if: you want to hold your own stock or build a private-label brand; or you need a clear refund promise before you pay, because the help centre and the terms say different things
honest_knock: The subscription only buys access: product costs, shipping, handling and transaction charges come on top of every order. Limited is too small to run a store on (20 inventory places, no monthly downloads), and Doba's refund terms contradict each other, from a 72-hour full refund in the help centre to 'all fees are non-refundable' in the terms.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-22 on doba.com/pricing with the Monthly, Quarterly and Annually toggles; prices in USD) Doba sells four subscription tiers. Billed monthly, Limited is $29.99 a month, Basic $59.99, Standard $149.99 and Enterprise $299.99. Quarterly billing takes 5% off (Limited $28.67, Basic $57.00, Standard $142.67 a month) and annual billing 15% (Limited $25.50, Basic $51.00, Standard $127.50 a month); Enterprise is sold monthly or annually only. Basic has a 7-day trial and Standard a 5-day trial, each for US$0.99. The fees policy says the full fee of the chosen tier is charged automatically when the trial ends, and the terms limit trials to first-time users. The subscription is not the whole bill: the fees policy says product costs, shipping, drop or order handling fees and transaction charges are paid separately at the time of purchase. Paid add-ons such as the AI Store Builder renew on their own cycle. On refunds Doba's own pages disagree: the help centre says a full refund is issued automatically if you cancel within 72 hours of payment, the fees policy excludes trial subscriptions, and the terms say all fees, including subscription fees, are non-refundable.

compare_with.name: Spocket
compare_with.why: Spocket is in our dossiers too and sells the same kind of supplier catalogue: when we read it on 1 October 2026 its Starter plan was $39.99 a month for 25 products. Doba's Limited is cheaper at $29.99 a month but caps the inventory list at 20 products and lists no monthly downloads, so the fair comparison is Doba Basic at $59.99. Compare the supplier range for your niche and the shipping times, not only the plan price.
